title: Delonix interop evidence record
description: One measured interoperability claim between the Delonix engine and a CNCF-ecosystem tool. Matches the shape of the suite evidence.jsonl records (reports/**/evidence.jsonl) and adds the compatibility dimensions the campaign requires: tool version, mode, host capabilities, result, proof. The generator scripts/gen_compatibility.py reads every tests/interop/results/*.jsonl line through this schema and renders docs/compatibility.md. Doctrine (AGENTS.md, 'Engine identity and boundary'; mission H): a 'compatible' claim (state PASS) exists only WITH a tool version and an artifact_ref that proves it; without a proof the state is NOT_TESTED, never 'compatible'.

tool.description: Ecosystem tool or standard the record is about (lower-kebab). E.g. 'kubernetes-cri', 'cilium', 'helm', 'harbor', 'spiffe-spire', 'oci-runtime'.

tool_version.description: The exact version of the tool that was exercised (e.g. 'v1.36.0', '1.16.5'). REQUIRED when state is PASS: a 'compatible' claim without the version it was proven against is not allowed.

delonix_version.description: The Delonix engine version used (root Cargo.toml version, e.g. '0.1.2'). REQUIRED when state is PASS.

mode.description: 1 = Delonix under a real Kubernetes (via the CRI). 2 = Delonix without Kubernetes (open interfaces only).

phase.description: The campaign phase that owns this claim.

state.description: PASS = works, proven (needs tool_version + artifact_ref). PARTIAL = partially works, measured (needs artifact_ref). FAIL = measured not to work (needs artifact_ref). NOT_TESTED = no proof yet (no artifact_ref).

privilege.description: The privilege tier the claim was measured under. Many CNCF DaemonSets (eBPF, hostNetwork, privileged) run root-only; the limits section records that rootless refuses them.

capabilities.description: Host capabilities the tool requires to run (H2). Drives both the matrix column and the rootless-refusal limits.

environment.description: Where it ran (host/VM, kubeadm/kind, CNI, uid). Same role as evidence.jsonl 'environment'.

command.description: The command(s) that produced the evidence.

artifact_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the proof (a report, a console capture, an evidence.jsonl). REQUIRED unless state is NOT_TESTED. This is the 'prova' column.

sha.description: The commit the measurement was taken at (short or full).

notes.description: One line of honest caveat: what was and was not exercised.
